title: Alkaline Earth Metals
notes: **Quick lime ($CaO$):** produced by calcining limestone: $CaCO_3 \rightarrow CaO + CO_2$. Used in steel making, cement, and drying agent.
**Bleaching powder ($CaOCl_2$):** $Ca(OH)_2 + Cl_2 \rightarrow CaOCl_2 + H_2O$. Used for bleaching and sterilizing water.
**Plaster of Paris ($CaSO_4 \cdot \frac{1}{2}H_2O$):** sets to hard gypsum on adding water: $CaSO_4 \cdot \frac{1}{2}H_2O + \frac{3}{2}H_2O \rightarrow CaSO_4 \cdot 2H_2O$. Used in casts and moulds.
**Magnesia ($MgO$):** refractory material for furnace linings, antacid, insulator in electric wires.
**Solubility trends:** hydroxides and sulphates become less soluble down group; carbonates become less soluble down group. $Be$ compounds are exceptions due to small size and high charge density.
**Thermal stability:** carbonates and nitrates become more stable down group. $MgCO_3$ decomposes at 350°C; $BaCO_3$ decomposes at 1360°C.
